Manage ERun cloud Kubernetes contexts

Usage:
  erun context [command]

Available Commands:
  disable-api-stop Lock a cloud context against stop calls (sets AWS DisableApiStop=true)
  enable-api-stop  Restore normal stop behaviour for a cloud context (sets AWS DisableApiStop=false)
  init             Create a managed cloud context
  list             List managed ERun cloud contexts
  start            Start a managed ERun cloud context
  stop             Stop a managed ERun cloud context

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for context

Global Flags:
      --output string   Result format: text (default, human stream) or json (structured result on stdout for orchestrators). (default "text")
      --time            Print the elapsed runtime after the command finishes.
  -v, --verbose count   Increase verbosity: -v streams external tool output, -vv adds erun command traces.

Use "erun context [command] --help" for more information about a command.
